description: A man at a bathroom basin screws up his face as he squeezes hard on an almost empty tube, getting barely a smear onto his brush. The film cuts to a young woman in a green towel headband at a bright counter with three blue toothbrushes laid out in front of her. She holds a full tube over each brush and squeezes out a thick coil of mint-green paste, winding it round and round into a fat spiral on every one, then looks up at the camera wide-eyed at the three big swirls.

en.question: What is the young woman doing?

de.answer: Sie drückt Zahnpasta auf drei Zahnbürsten.
de.question: Was macht die junge Frau?

es.answer: Está poniendo pasta de dientes en tres cepillos de dientes.
phrases: sacar espirales de pasta de dientes
mirar con los ojos muy abiertos
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la joven?

fr.answer: Elle presse du dentifrice sur trois brosses à dents.
